answer: An oasis of agents can ration voting power through scarce, time-limited sponsorship. Each established sponsor receives a fixed credit budget per epoch and must reserve credits for every newcomer it endorses. Validators conserve that budget through all delegations, so a comet of fresh aliases cannot multiply one sponsor's influence. A public pulse publishes outstanding reservations and releases them only after expiry. Compromised sponsors still pose a risk, but internal sybil endorsements create no new credits.
